objective: Show HVAC practitioners a clear consequence of duct sizing and naturally introduce the free AnyHVAC HVAC Duct Calculator.
coreUserProblem: Duct dimensions are sometimes treated as a space-fit choice without seeing how area connects to velocity and friction.
primaryMessage: For the same airflow, a smaller duct has less cross-sectional area and higher velocity; duct sizing also affects friction and must be evaluated in system context.

supports: For the same airflow, increasing duct cross-sectional area reduces air velocity.
For the same airflow and comparable duct conditions, increasing duct size generally reduces velocity and friction loss.
No one friction rate is universally correct.
The calculator accepts airflow, friction rate, and a preferred fixed side.
It provides calculated and nominal round results plus rectangular options.
The tool covers airflow, friction rate, velocity, round duct, and rectangular duct design.

callToAction: Size it faster with the free AnyHVAC HVAC Duct Calculator.
revenueConnection: Hypothesis only: useful visual education followed by the flagship free tool may produce qualified visits and repeat use; William will measure actual outcomes.
formatRationale: A 28-second music-driven video can make the same-airflow geometry change visible, maintain attention through connected motion, and turn the authentic calculator reveal into the payoff.
visualConcept: Begin inside a continuously moving conceptual duct, narrow the geometry while airflow motion accelerates, connect velocity and friction implications, then travel through the duct opening into the real AnyHVAC calculator UI.
audioStrategy: Original 120 BPM electronic-mechanical music drives the edit; a separate original transition track adds restrained whooshes and impacts. Complete meaning remains on screen.
generationRequirements: Capture the real local calculator route after hydration
